name: 皮のテント
notes: Reviewed the exact reduced GLB from six views: A-frame roof silhouette, hide panels and seams, lashed wooden supports, interior cross-members and entrance remain coherent. Height 3.5 m, ground-centred pivot. This reconstruction is an open-ended shelter with no closed back wall; accepted for the prototype camp and not filled with generated primitive geometry. Minor pole and seam simplification remains. No LODs delivered because four copies of the 24603-triangle mesh are sufficient pending whole-game performance QA.

provenance.reconstruction: Local TRELLIS-2; settings and dense SHA in model workspace
